name: What is the process for professional window air leak repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional window air leak repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our professional repair process begins with a thorough inspection to identify all air leak sources around your windows. We then remove old, failing caulk or weatherstripping. Depending on the extent of the leaks, we may apply new, high-quality sealant, replace worn-out weatherstripping, or address gaps in the window frame structure. Our goal is to create an airtight seal, improving your home's energy efficiency and comfort. We ensure minimal disruption during the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspecting for leaks, removing old sealant, and then applying new caulk or replacing weatherstripping to create an airtight seal and improve energy efficiency.
